ordinals.title: Update README: Qwen 3.5-4B, LoRA v20+, current WebUI pages, FAQ refresh
ordinals.finding: README changed model/LoRA/page/topology and support claims while retaining a pre-release warning that the required custom LoRA was not included. Current-model behavior claims are epoch-bound and source-reported unless runtime-verified.

ordinals.title: Projects: Drag & drop files into chat
ordinals.finding: Dropped project files were uploaded and text previews injected into the agent prompt. File bytes/content, preview text, user instruction and trusted project state therefore require separate provenance/trust classes before model/tool use.

ordinals.title: Projects: Fix page-level scroll — override .page overflow and padding
Projects: Fix scroll — min-height:0 on all flex children
Projects: Markdown rendering in chat (bold, code blocks, lists)
ordinals.finding: Assistant markdown was converted to HTML and inserted into the page without an explicit escaping/sanitization step in the shown renderer. Generated or file-derived text rendered as HTML requires strict escaping/allowlist handling before DOM insertion.

ordinals.title: Projects: Single-screen layout — compact topbar, workspace fills viewport
Fix streaming endpoint parameter (Request → body: dict)
ordinals.finding: FastAPI endpoint declaration did not bind request input as intended; after changing to a typed body dict, source reports end-to-end streaming/tool tests succeeded. Interface contracts should be schema-tested, not inferred from framework conventions.

ordinals.title: Projects: Context compaction, SSE streaming, task tracking, max 25 iterations
ordinals.finding: Long-agent sessions gained context compaction, persistent task files and increased iteration budget. The commit explicitly states structural verification only because API credits were insufficient; k22 later upgrades the testing state. Structural correctness and end-to-end validation must remain separate evidence statuses.

ordinals.title: Projects: Full system access — no sandbox, like Claude Code terminal
ordinals.finding: The project-directory sandbox was intentionally removed and the agent gained system-wide shell/read/write/edit/list access, with only a small destructive-command substring blocklist. Capability scope and effect approval cannot be replaced by a narrow blacklist once an agent has full host authority.

ordinals.title: Projects: Tool-use agent loop — Claude can now execute code and edit files
ordinals.finding: Introduced the initial project-scoped tool loop with bounded iterations, path containment and exact-match editing. This is the safer predecessor to k24 and provides the explicit authority/sandbox supersession boundary.

ordinals.title: Projects: PROJECT.md as base of truth for Claude
ordinals.finding: PROJECT.md was injected every turn as base-of-truth and model-emitted update blocks were automatically parsed and written back to that same authoritative file. Generative suggestions can therefore self-condition future truth unless proposals, authority, provenance and committed state are separated.

ordinals.title: Projects: Visual redesign, drag & drop, file search, open folder, AI sort
ordinals.finding: Project upload/open/search/sort endpoints expanded file effects. Upload path attempted project-root containment; sorting moved files by extension. File ingestion and automatic reorganization require effect receipts, collision/rollback policy and content/provenance handling beyond UI convenience.

ordinals.title: Projects page: Claude Code Agent with Frank peripherals (Titan + Hypotheses)
ordinals.finding: Created per-project Claude workspaces with their own chat, memory, hypotheses and filesystem folder, explicitly stating Claude is not Frank and omitting Frank consciousness/SOMA. This is strong lineage for separating agent identity/role and per-project memory from the host entity.

ordinals.title: Feed: Fix 14 broken RSS feeds, replace with working alternatives
ordinals.finding: Unavailable primary/specialized feeds were replaced partly by HNRSS topic queries and broad fallback feeds. A working source is not epistemically equivalent to the source it replaces; source identity, authority and aggregation bias must persist through fallback.

ordinals.title: Feed: Fix double /feed prefix in API calls
ordinals.finding: Client helper and call sites both encoded a feed prefix, producing invalid routes. API ownership/prefix composition should be centralized and contract-tested.

ordinals.title: Feed: Add /api/feed proxy routes, fix JS API path
ordinals.finding: WebUI/feed proxy routing was missing and client calls targeted the wrong API namespace until explicit feed proxy routes were added. Cross-service proxy contracts are part of executable topology and should be automatically validated.

negative_results_preserved: A full project sandbox was removed and replaced by near-unrestricted system access plus a tiny destructive-command blocklist.
A model could automatically rewrite the same PROJECT.md that was injected as its future base of truth.
An SSE endpoint was structurally implemented but not live-tested because API credits were insufficient until a later fix/test.
Generated markdown was rendered into HTML without an explicit escaping step in the shown renderer.
RSS availability fixes changed source identity and often substituted aggregate topic search for unavailable primary feeds.
API route prefix ownership drift caused doubled or missing feed namespaces.
measurement_boundary: All source-reported model/LoRA iteration counts, performance, uptime and benchmark claims are historical source claims unless independently reproduced. k23's initial streaming/tool implementation was explicitly structural-only at that commit; k22 records the later source-reported end-to-end test state.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual-dedup audit against HISTORICAL_EARNED_WORK was performed.
